entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: An American Wild West-inspired desert frontier plane, favored by famous villains who travel via Omenpaths.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths through the Blind Eternities whose opening overran Thunder Junction with outlaws and awoke its wild magic.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which the Omenpaths travel.

entities.name: Thunder
entities.description: The wild magic of Thunder Junction, appearing as chaotic blue lightning and put to use in tools and thunder blasters.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: An ancient artifact locked at the plane's center, rumored to hide untold riches and power.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: What passes for the law around Prosperity, led by Bertram Graywater, mainly protecting their riches.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: Leader of the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Bandits and criminals based in Tarnation, led by Akul, who relied on Fire and Thunder magic.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Leader of the Hellspurs who built Tarnation around the vault.

entities.name: Slickshot Gang
entities.description: A band of outlaws and thunderslingers for hire led by crime boss Lilah.

entities.name: Lilah
entities.description: The crime boss leading the Slickshot Gang.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: Nomadic hunters and outlaws who live off the land.

entities.name: Outcasters
entities.description: Scattered groups of hermits and outlaws in small ramshackle towns.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: People of New Capenna who constructed railroads on the plane.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker from Ravnica building relay towers for a communication network across the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker whose band of outlaws hides in the Wildcard Saloon.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A resident whose ranch sits on the outskirts of Saddlebrush.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A non-planeswalker visitor to the plane.

entities.name: Cactusfolk
entities.description: The only known sapient race native to Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: A desert town where many Omenpaths open and a relay tower stands.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: The wealthiest metropolis on Thunder Junction, under the Sterling Company's control.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: A town built around the vault by Akul and the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Rustwood
entities.description: A failed ranching town, now mostly abandoned.

entities.name: Thief's Folly
entities.description: A graveyard for prospectors, with tombs from dozens of planes.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: A quiet isolated town near Annie Flash's ranch.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that did not target Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Before the Omenpaths opened, Thunder Junction was unspoiled and uninhabited.
events.quote: Before the Omenpaths opened, Thunder Junction was an unspoiled, uninhabited plane.

events.summary: After the Omenpaths open, the plane is overrun with outlaws, Riveteers build railroads, Ral Zarek builds relay towers, and the Sterling Company keeps peace.
events.quote: After the opening of the Omenpaths, Thunder Junction was overrun with outlaws

events.summary: The opening of the Omenpaths awakens the plane's wild magic, which settlers dub thunder.
events.quote: The opening of the Omenpaths awoke the wild magic of Thunder Junction.
